approval_source.question_set: Whether the application startup budget (process_startup_millis, P01_E05_VALUES_4) or its 60 s code cap changes after the startup checkpoint (user, 13 November 2026: 'proceed with your recommendations on the remaining items')

reason: Staging sentry startup failure of 2026-11-10 (BOUNDED_STARTUP_FAILURE, height 173,074); root cause in draft PR #135, fix in PR #136. With PR #136 startup work is bounded by the blocks after the checkpoint (normally 0 to a few), not by history length.

decisions.question: process_startup_millis and the 60000 ms code cap (config.rs:59-66)
decisions.selected: Keep 60000 ms and the code cap; the one-time complete check runs through dytallix-state-check --write-startup-checkpoint, outside the budget
decisions.rule: The budget is never raised to fit a complete history check; a node without a checkpoint is brought up by the maintenance command.

does_not_authorize: Any change to other P01_E05_VALUES_4 values
Running the maintenance command on any host
